title: Run W-5: Mn-doped NiTe2
subtitle: Strict budget: 12 measurements, 14 days · delivered B006 · passed
task: Dope NiTe2 with Mn. Above a critical Mn content the structure distorts to a lower symmetry, and the device needs that distorted phase. Deliver a single-phase sample of the distorted phase whose magnetic ordering temperature is 247.9 ± 3.0 K and whose oxide content is below 0.5 wt%. Budget: 12 measurements (XRD, M(T), EDX) and 14 simulated days; every sample is made step by step on the bench.

outcome.headline: Delivered B006: distorted, single phase, ordering temperature 247.6 K against a 247.9 ± 3 K target.
